bounded_contexts.name: cloud-billing
bounded_contexts.description: Code-backed Cloud Billing local foundation for billing account, cloud billing event, platform metering handoff, invoice arithmetic, tenant class, billable component, and metering/invoice/tax/audit evidence metadata guardrails. No live billing REST server, SDK, worker, settlement rail, payment processor, tax authority adapter, FOCUS export runtime, database, Kafka, Valkey, measured SLO, active-active DR, OpenTofu plan/apply, provider-live smoke, or audit-chain persistence is claimed by CS-CLOUD-BILLING-TAX-001.

contracts.contract_status: schemas exist; local Rust domain/kernel validates billing and metering metadata but no billing transport, outbox, REST, gRPC, worker, or broker runtime is implemented

hyperscaler_inv_coverage.tenant_rate_limit: not_claimed_cs_cloud_billing_tax_001: no implemented per-tenant runtime API quota/rate-limit enforcement beyond local metadata guardrails
hyperscaler_inv_coverage.golden_signals: not_claimed_cs_cloud_billing_tax_001: no implemented metrics/OpenSLO/golden-signal emission evidence

audit_chain.non_claim: CS-CLOUD-BILLING-TAX-001 records a multispectrum evidence bundle and audit-chain row only; it does not implement Cloud Billing runtime audit emission, Merkle sealing, or persistence.

secrets_substrate.non_claim: No raw payment credential, tax authority credential, provider credential, API key, bearer token, database password, or tenant financial payload is introduced or consumed by this local foundation. Evidence refs are validated as non-secret references only.

mesh_layering.non_claim: No live Cloud Billing pod, service mesh policy, database proxy, message broker, or network path is deployed by CS-CLOUD-BILLING-TAX-001.

billing_foundation.non_claim: Rust guardrails validate billing/metering/invoice/tax/audit metadata only. They do not ingest live usage, charge customers, settle revenue, export FOCUS datasets, persist invoices, or emit audit-chain events.

data_classification: PUBLIC metadata, INTERNAL_ONLY control-plane metadata, FINANCIAL value metadata, AUDIT evidence; no tenant payment credential, raw tax credential, customer PII, settlement payload, or live invoice persistence is implemented by this ChangeSet

capacity_model.notes: CS-CLOUD-BILLING-TAX-001 is metadata/domain/kernel validation only. Runtime billing events, invoice workers, databases, brokers, capacity telemetry, autoscaling, and SLOs remain explicit non-claims.

sharding_automation.non_claim: No ledger shard split, billing/tax worker migration, tenant migration, or audit-chain persistence is implemented by CS-CLOUD-BILLING-TAX-001.

dr.non_claim: No live billing ledger replication, tax catalog replication, warm standby, failover, restore drill, or DR measurement evidence is implemented by CS-CLOUD-BILLING-TAX-001.

pod_runtime_tier_justification: Cloud Billing is intended Tier-2 first-party financial application workload. CS-CLOUD-BILLING-TAX-001 has no runtime pod deployment; tier is retained as intended future isolation class only.

tenant_version_pinning.non_claim: Contracts are schemas for current local metadata behavior, but no per-tenant API version pinning runtime is implemented by CS-CLOUD-BILLING-TAX-001.

explicit_non_claims: No live billing REST/gRPC server, SDK, worker, message broker, metering outbox, database ledger, payment processor, settlement rail, tax authority adapter, FOCUS export, OpenTofu plan/apply, provider-live smoke, measured SLO, capacity telemetry, DR, or audit-chain runtime persistence is implemented.
Legacy Markdown benchmark/parity/runbook/implementation-plan files under microservices/cloud-billing remain planning/prose and are not readiness evidence for CS-CLOUD-BILLING-TAX-001.
